result.summary: Overall layout is functional with a couple of minor visual and truncation issues.

issues.description: Rightmost category filter and restaurant cards are clipped at the screen edge.
issues.suggestion: Add proper right-edge content padding to indicate horizontal scrollability clearly.

issues.description: Red badge dot on the top right profile/notification icon is slightly offset.
issues.suggestion: Adjust badge alignment to fit neatly inside the icon boundary.
